caption: The plan page of the app Way Store Locator in the Shopify admin of our development store, with the title Way: Google Maps Store Locator and the text Pick your plan to start a 7-days* free trial, the switch Monthly (selected) or Yearly (Save up to 20%), and four cards: Free Plan $0/month (1 location, Floating store locator, Online support, In-Store App Branding), Basic Plan $6.99/month (No App Branding, Up to 50 locations, Widget & App Block, Bulk locations import, Multiple locations pop up, Customizable design, No API key required, Navigate with Google Maps, Custom CSS, Online support), Advanced Plan $14.99/month (Up to 500 locations) and Pro Plan $29.99/month (Up to 2000 locations), each with the button Choose Plan. A footnote says Each store is entitled to a maximum of undefined trial days altogether. The store name at the bottom of the left menu is covered.

The page Store Locator Settings of the app (status Active) after the first location was added: a yellow bar ACTION REQUIRED: Turn on Way Store Locator's App Embed with the button Enable App Embed, a blue block Show a map on your store pages with the text Embedding the map into your store pages is available on paid plans. Upgrade to activate the app block, the tab Store Locations with the first location Test Stockist One (Museumstraat 1, a public address) and 0 Clicks, and a Preview block with the tab Icon showing a grey pin (the tab Map is greyed out). A banner above says BLACK FRIDAY SALE: Up To 50% OFF.

The theme editor preview (not saved) of the home page of our development store with the panel App embeds open: the switch of Way Store Locator is turned on, and in the lower right corner of the preview a grey floating pin with the link Way Store Locator appears. The store name in the header of the preview is covered.
